mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting glucagon to liver glycogen was most worthwhile: the planned sequence shows both glucose release and the subsequent reduction in the signal.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding meal glucose to the body was straightforward setup, but its picture plan added little beyond the item and goal descriptions.

surprise.text: The parallel feedback sequences made the contrast between insulin after a meal and glucagon between meals especially clear.

arbitrary.text: No action lacked a clear purpose, although each decision offered only one combination, so the sequence involved little choice.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter for the connected biology, but the single-option sequence offered little meaningful decision-making. These picture descriptions alone cannot establish how students would experience or understand it.
